questions.prompt: Which overall plan matches the heap / priority queue approach for Longest Happy String?

choices.label: Always choose the most frequent letter even after using it twice in a row.
choices.feedback: A third equal consecutive letter is forbidden.

choices.label: Require all letters to be exhausted even if none can be appended legally.
choices.feedback: Some inputs cannot use every occurrence without creating a triple.

choices.label: Stop as soon as the largest-count letter is temporarily blocked.
choices.feedback: Another available letter may allow a longer valid result.

choices.label: Prefer the most frequent remaining letter. If it would create three identical consecutive letters, use the next candidate or stop if none exists.
